item.title: Database upgrades: PostgreSQL 19, Aurora PostgreSQL 18, and Aurora MySQL 8.4
item.description: Today’s Database Daily looks at PostgreSQL 19 Beta 2, Aurora PostgreSQL 18, Aurora MySQL 8.4, and the practical steps database teams can take to prepare for major-version upgrades.

item.title: Aurora PostgreSQL 18, Aurora MySQL 8.4, and the latest SQL Server patching
item.description: A DBA-focused look at Aurora PostgreSQL 18.3, Aurora MySQL 8.4 security and upgrade considerations, extended support for Aurora MySQL 5.7 compatibility, and the latest SQL Server cumulative and security updates.
